checks.location: Physical pp.1-6; Theorems 0.1-0.2 and introductory comparisons
checks.checks: Closed, connected, oriented real hyperbolic manifold; n>=3; equal volumes; entropy tends to n-1. Separate intrinsic complement metric from restricted ambient metric and intrinsic isomorphism from ambient current-space isometry.
checks.result: Main statements and their limitations checked. Stronger uniqueness remains open; no claim of full-space convergence.

checks.checks: Metric-current definitions, support, positive-density set, multiplicity, orientation, flat and weak convergence, current pushforward; compact target and uniform Lipschitz maps.
checks.result: Sormani Theorem 6.1 and BCS Lemma 7.3 checked in original passages. Injective Banach extension plus linear homotopy on fixed finite-mass current gives pushforward convergence.

checks.location: p.9 Assumption 1.3(a)-(e); p.11 equation (3); p.12 bad-region mass
checks.checks: Explicit assumptions control unweighted support volume, not integer multiplicity or mass convergence.
checks.result: Supported Minor P001: connected weighted-bubble counterexample meets every stated hypothesis and refutes equation (3) and M(S_i)->Vol(N). It does not refute Proposition 1.4's conclusion.

checks.checks: Area formula, essentially single-sheeted good region, coarea curve lifts, boundary avoidance, near-isometry on good regions, compactness of support and limiting inverse.
checks.result: Checked with intended unit multiplicity/mass control. Discarding the preimage of the bad-region image ensures endpoint fibers are unique. The additional local bound in part (2) is necessary; shortcut example checked.

checks.location: pp.15-16; spherical quotient, admissible maps and Definition 2.3
checks.checks: Torsion-free regular action free/proper, marked identity homotopy class, quotient diameter, boundaryless pushforward cycles, minimizing sequence.
checks.result: Free/proper action independently checked using vanishing regular matrix coefficients and impossibility of an l2 vector constant along an infinite orbit. Compactness hypotheses match.

checks.checks: Modified distance kappa(r)=log cosh r at c=1; smooth extension at zero; strict convexity and properness of a finite weighted sum.
checks.result: Independent Hessian calculation gives Hess rho=g-drho tensor drho exactly. Existence, uniqueness, equivariance and finite-support restriction checked.

checks.checks: Derivative equation, H/K matrices, trace H<1, K>=I-H, Jacobian bound and near equality.
checks.result: Independent sharp eigenvalue optimization including boundary corners and n=3 gap; qualitative stability, singular-value lower bound and nearby Lipschitz propagation verified.

checks.checks: Marked finite-support/polyhedral approximation, degree-one pushforward, minimizing mass, Jacobian near equality, shrinking collar selection.
checks.result: Song Lemma 1.6 and Theorem 4.1 checked. Approximation must retain homotopy/embedding by generic high-codimension perturbation. Main application has mass control beyond Assumption 1.3.

checks.checks: Coarea choice of collar radii, vanishing boundary mass, uniform local Lipschitz bounds and Proposition 1.4(2).
checks.result: Choose radii tending to zero slowly relative to discarded mass. Short-curve control is needed only on such sufficiently small collars, not every radius below one. Current-preserving intrinsic isomorphism follows.

checks.checks: c>entropy ensures exponential kernel integrability; L2 normalization; fundamental-domain norm map; equivariance; a.e. distance gradient.
checks.result: Independent Hilbert-space projection and reverse triangle inequality give sum |dP_c(e_j)|^2<=c^2/4. No differentiability at cut locus is assumed.

checks.checks: Rescaling entropy to 2 sqrt(n), trace bound, AM-GM, spherical volume lower bound, near-isometry on good regions, smooth boundaries.
checks.result: Constants and quantifiers checked. Near-maximal determinant and trace imply each singular value tends to one; barycenter composition treated similarly.

checks.checks: Clipped metric min(intrinsic distance,6D), bounded mass, vanishing boundary mass, finite diameter, complete ambient spaces.
checks.result: Wenger original Theorem 1.2 allows boundaries and applies. The clipped metric is finite, locally unchanged, and handles disconnected regions. D_i is explicitly the unit current.

checks.checks: Limit diameter<=D; distances below cutoff; restriction by slicing; mass lower bound under degree-one pushforward.
checks.result: Cutoff inactive near limit support. Jacobian upper bound and target mass give volume retention and current mass difference tending to zero, hence return to original intrinsic metrics.

checks.checks: Intrinsic flat limits need not be Hausdorff limits; finite nets, inner and outer neighborhoods, coarea, lower intrinsic-ball volume.
checks.result: Checked using finite chains along limit geodesics and a thinner inner neighborhood to preserve s>2t buffer. Does not rely on a literal uniform inclusion of all outer ambient balls. New intrinsic limit may differ, as source states.

checks.checks: Equidistribution of lifted geodesic spheres, normalized invariant probability measures and continuous test functions.
checks.result: Eskin-McMullen general semisimple/symmetric-space hypotheses and proof passages checked. Hyperbolic cocompact lattice and compact stabilizer meet them; pushforward to unit tangent bundle supplies result.

checks.checks: Open-set lower bound, positive-frequency visits, directions S^(n-1), disjoint fixed-length blocks, all large real times.
checks.result: Continuous bump avoids unjustified indicator convergence. Independently derived P(X>=c/2)>=c/(2-c). Finite initial and final blocks are negligible. Printed S^2 is only a notation slip.

checks.location: pp.31-32; Theorem 3.5 assumptions and path lifting
checks.checks: Bi-Lipschitz 1-Lipschitz limiting map; arbitrary small additive error; global homotopy equivalences; intrinsic open-region path metrics.
checks.result: Fine subdivision below injectivity radius controls homotopy even without Lipschitz f_i. Approximate endpoints and near-minimizing paths absorb errors using a strict shortcut margin.

checks.location: pp.32-34; uniform shortcut and orbit counting
checks.checks: Fixed positive gap, bounded hyperbolic length, finitely many homotopy classes, uniform positive visitation, distinct loop classes.
checks.result: Uniform constants obtained by subselection/finite minimum. Positive-area sphere family and bounded fundamental domain give exponential orbit count. Length reduction gives uniform entropy gap (n-1)/(1-theta)>n-1.

checks.checks: Uniqueness of all subsequential limits; full-sequence selection; mass convergence; weak convergence of mass measures.
checks.result: Error-functional selection provides full sequence. Portegies Lemma 2.7 in acquired v2 matches cited published Lemma 2.1. Its total-mass hypothesis is satisfied after removal of negligible regions.

checks.location: p.35 Remark 3.9; pp.36-38 bibliography and source identity
checks.checks: Euclidean q-area interpretation, boundary area bound, nonoptimality caveat, funding/version data and references.
checks.result: 1-Lipschitz (n-1)-area bounded by boundary area. No stronger width claim adopted. Actual title, author, DOI, journal pages and received/revised/accepted dates visually checked.

checks.location: Independent evidence and exact native calculation
checks.checks: Connected weighted-bubble geometry, flat fillings, mass formula, polynomial identity and n=3 boundary maximum.
checks.result: All analytic hypotheses proved in evidence/report. Native Fraction and polynomial arithmetic exited 0. Finite tests are algebraic supplements, not substitutes for the infinite-sequence proof.

unresolved_scientific_or_source_checks.item: Core cited results checked at original statement and relevant proof-passage level; no recursive audit of every foundational reference.
The original Besson-Courtois-Gallot papers were not all acquired/read in full. Required real-hyperbolic matrix bound proved independently; detailed Song exposition and its applications checked.
Acquired arXiv/author/MPI versions are identified. No journal-byte equivalence for those references asserted. Publisher webpage denial not bypassed; public primary preprint acquired normally.
No claim of full ambient uniqueness, convergence of unmodified manifolds, or verification of unrelated rank-one extensions.

independent_acceptance.scope: Focused independent verification of the one reported multiplicity Problem, every explicit geometric/current hypothesis, flat filling estimates, pushforward and fixed-neighborhood mass contradiction, with actual mass controls in both main applications checked.
